product.summary: UniSat open-source non-custodial Bitcoin browser-extension wallet.
product.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; iOS and Android wallet applications are deferred.

events.title: UniSat Wallet v1.0.3 released
events.description: UniSat published its v1.0.3 wallet update with layout changes, script-safety changes, local-storage cleanup, and bug fixes, documenting active browser-extension maintenance in February 2023.

events.title: UniSat Wallet extension v1.6.0 removed Atomicals support and fixed Keystone signing
events.description: UniSat Wallet extension v1.6.0 was published on 2025-04-03, removing Atomicals token support, fixing Keystone hardware-wallet signing bugs and potential vulnerabilities, and improving wallet loading speed.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet Download
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirms the open-source non-custodial Chrome extension and separately lists iOS/Android downloads.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet official repositories
evidence.notes: The official UniSat Wallet GitHub organization identifies the active wallet monorepo as the official repository for browser extension, mobile apps, and shared wallet infrastructure. The older extension repository is marked deprecated and migrated.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet - v1.0.3 update
evidence.notes: First-party UniSat update announcing Wallet v1.0.3 on 2023-02-24.

evidence.title: UniSat Wallet Extension v1.6.0
evidence.notes: Official UniSat Wallet extension release documents Atomicals removal, Keystone signing fixes, vulnerability fixes, and wallet loading improvements.
